name: Mochify API
description: Mochify's REST API for zero-retention image compression, PDF page extraction/splitting, and AI image generation. Images and PDFs are streamed into RAM at api.mochify.app, processed, and returned; the original bytes are never written to disk. Authenticate with an x-api-key header (dashboard-issued key) for quota tracking, or omit auth entirely for anonymous, IP-metered use on the free tier.
